execution.interleaveRule: For each replicate ordinal, A then B then C when C exists; never overlap cells.
execution.tokenCapFormula: For each (cap family, milestone), 2 * the largest validator-clean green pilot fresh-input-plus-output count; where any registered condition lacks that figure, LLP 0201's 2,000,000-token safety figure is used and doubled to 4,000,000. Capstone M7 has a complete 331,698-token fresh-session figure, doubled to 663,396. Grok has no approved native adapter and remains null/advisory.

mac17-3-m5-10core-loadavg-10-approved.ruling: Loadavg-1/loadavg-5/loadavg-15 <= 10.00; any single exceeding sample contaminates the cell; three consecutive one-minute passes precede admission.
mac17-3-m5-10core-loadavg-10-approved.breachRule: Any sample above any ceiling sets host-load-contamination.
mac17-3-m5-10core-loadavg-10-approved.nextCellRule: Exclusive host lock; prior process tree closed; all main and M7 campaign ports unbound; disk floor passes; three consecutive load passes.

diskPolicy.cleanupOrder: Commit the record or blocked report, seal the cell, delete only rebuildable workspace outputs, then evaluate the next admission.

portPolicy.allCampaignPorts: union of every cell.ports and every present cell.m7Ports

execution.apiInterruptionRule: Any provider/API interruption makes the cell scorecard-ineligible; retain product findings.

recording.eligibilityRule: Missing phase metering, any load ceiling breach, or any API interruption makes a cell scorecard-ineligible; a full-journey row additionally requires M7 session metering; product findings remain retained.

successfulCompletion.milestoneRule: all registered milestones green for the leg profile

successFloor.failedReplicateUse: A fully metered failed replicate enters failure-rate reporting only and never token or correction ratios.
